official_sources.supports: NVRTC returns PTX that can be loaded through the driver module API. It can run without a GPU. This supports preparing a bound artifact, not a speed or compatibility guarantee.
Driver module-data loading accepts compiled input and has its own resource/lifetime/error contract. Precompilation does not make loading or JIT free.
